newsitem.title: USA: Saba adopts capital budget of $53.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Saba adopts capital budget of $53.9 mln.

text.p: Saba Petroleum Co said its board adopted a capital budget for 1997 of $53.9 million, an increase of about $42 million over its capital expenditures for 1996.

The capital budget covers expenditures for exploration, development activities and acquisitions. Saba said the increased level of activities would be supported by cash flow from presently producing wells and scheduled development activities, dispositions of properties which do not fit with its strategic plan, and drawing on lines of credit, which are expected to be increased during 1997.
